# standards 0.0.5: highlights

The hand-written part of the release notes; scripts/release.py adds the rest.

* **Signed releases you can check offline**: each release now carries its build provenance (`standards-sync-<version>.intoto.jsonl`) and a Sigstore signature of `SHA256SUMS`, and every earlier release has an SSH signature of its checksums from a key in `KEYS.asc`. `docs/VERIFYING.md` has the commands.
